capabilities: Converts PDF, Office, OpenDocument, ebook, web, email, notebook, subtitle and spreadsheet files to Markdown notes
Rebuilds headings, lists, tables and embedded images at their original positions
Extracts invoice, receipt and bank statement fields into note properties
Runs local Tesseract OCR on images and scanned PDF pages
Reports coverage, skipped items and guessed fields in frontmatter and a callout
extras: Desktop only, because it uses Node's zlib. The OCR engine and English model download from jsdelivr on the first image or scanned-page conversion, or can be supplied from a vault folder for blocked networks; OCR is English only. Legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt and iWork files are not supported.
intentEvidence: The Obsidian plugins in this space wrap Microsoft's markitdown, which is one abstraction over every format
motivation: The author built it because the existing plugins in this space wrap markitdown, which needs Python installed and makes one-size-fits-all decisions about what structure means.
problem: Files in a vault that are not Markdown, such as PDFs, Office documents and scans, cannot be read, searched or linked as notes inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: The Obsidian plugins in this space wrap Microsoft's markitdown, which is one abstraction over every format
Pairs well with Doc Preview, also by this author: it renders .pptx/.docx/.xlsx files in an Obsidian tab

summary: Converts PDF, Office, OpenDocument, ebook, web, email, notebook, subtitle, spreadsheet and image files into Markdown notes.
